value.rationale: An all-parameter equivariant Euler-character formula has structural content beyond ordinary Euler characteristic, including parity-dependent eigenmodules and all conjugacy-class values; moreover, combined with any established concentration theorem it identifies the actual homology module. It is a motivated invariant of an established graph-topology family, not a numerical one-off.
